referral_links_scope_merchant_check.name: referral_links_scope_merchant_check
referral_links_scope_merchant_check.value: ("scope" = 'merchant' AND "merchant_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("scope" = 'cross_merchant' AND "merchant_id" IS NULL)

business_accounts_shopify_idx.name: business_accounts_shopify_idx
business_accounts_shopify_idx.where: shopify_user_id IS NOT NULL AND shopify_shop_domain IS NOT NULL

install_codes_credential_present.name: install_codes_credential_present
install_codes_credential_present.value: "anonymous_id" IS NOT NULL OR "checkout_token" IS NOT NULL

merchant_admins_identity_check.name: merchant_admins_identity_check
merchant_admins_identity_check.value: "merchant_admins"."wallet" IS NOT NULL OR "merchant_admins"."account_id" IS NOT NULL

merchant_ownership_transfers_from_check.name: merchant_ownership_transfers_from_check
merchant_ownership_transfers_from_check.value: "merchant_ownership_transfers"."from_wallet" IS NOT NULL OR "merchant_ownership_transfers"."from_account_id" IS NOT NULL

merchant_ownership_transfers_to_check.name: merchant_ownership_transfers_to_check
merchant_ownership_transfers_to_check.value: "merchant_ownership_transfers"."to_wallet" IS NOT NULL OR "merchant_ownership_transfers"."to_account_id" IS NOT NULL

merchants_owner_check.name: merchants_owner_check
merchants_owner_check.value: "merchants"."owner_wallet" IS NOT NULL OR "merchants"."owner_account_id" IS NOT NULL

notification_broadcasts_scheduled_at_idx.name: notification_broadcasts_scheduled_at_idx
notification_broadcasts_scheduled_at_idx.where: "notification_broadcasts"."scheduled_at" is not null and "notification_broadcasts"."claimed_at" is null

interaction_logs_unprocessed_idx.name: interaction_logs_unprocessed_idx
interaction_logs_unprocessed_idx.where: "processed_at" IS NULL AND "cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "identity_group_id" IS NOT NULL
